hotspots.label: Diplomatic Annexations (Subsidiary Alliance & Doctrine of Lapse)
hotspots.popover_description: Lord Wellesley's Subsidiary Alliance and Lord Dalhousie's Doctrine of Lapse annexed heirless and vulnerable princely states.

hotspots.label: Deindustrialization & Drain of Wealth
hotspots.popover_description: Unfair tariffs ruined Indian handloom weavers while Manchester cloth flooded markets; wealth was remitted to Britain.

hotspots.label: 1857 Great Rebellion & 1858 Crown Transfer
hotspots.popover_description: Popular uprising of sepoys, peasants, and dispossessed princes leading to the Government of India Act 1858.
